FAF_ALLOWED_ROOTS=/srv/faf-project is operator-controlled, stable and nonempty. Both project root and requested fixture are existing ordinary directories/files with no symlinks or races.

Caller supplies {path: /srv/faf-outside/fixture.txt}; the outside regular text file is readable by the process, below 50MiB, not under /etc, /sys, /proc, /private/etc or a temp directory, and contains no '..' path component. The configured allowed root is not caller-influenced. No custom filesystem hooks, changed cwd/environment, method replacement, filesystem access denial or concurrent renames. Only initial read confinement is labeled; not all context-file tools, arbitrary deployment roots, symlink-race prevention or runtime safety.
